caption:
अभी फिल्म रिलीज भी नहीं हुई और एवेंजर्स डूम्सडे ने दुनिया भर में तहलका मचा दिया है।
प्री-सेल्स के दम पर ही यह साल की सबसे बड़ी सुपरहीरो फिल्म बन गई है।
इसने तो सुपरगर्ल और एंडगेम जैसे बड़े नामों को भी पीछे छोड़ दिया है।
हॉलीवुड का यह क्रेज देखकर लग रहा है कि बॉक्स ऑफिस पर बड़ा धमाका होने वाला है।
क्या आप इस फिल्म के लिए एक्साइटेड हैं या फिर किसी और का इंतजार है?

ctx.text:
Avengers: Doomsday has not even been released in theaters, and it is already setting new box-office records worldwide. It is already one of the highest-grossing superhero movies of the year worldwide. It has beaten DC’s Supergirl and Avengers: Endgame Encore to become one of the biggest superhero movies of the year, according to the latest reports. Keep scrolling for the deets.
Spider-Man: Brand New Day is 2026’s highest-grossing superhero movie at the worldwide box office. The movie has also emerged as the all-time biggest film at the North American box office. Doomsday is already competing with the Tom Holland starrer solo superhero movie. The Robert Downey Jr. starrer is also expected to challenge Brand New Day’s record opening weekend domestically.
According to several media reports, Avengers: Doomsday has already collected more than $150 million in worldwide ticket pre-sales. It has collected an estimated $70 million+ from the North American box office alone. Avengers: Doomsday is the 4th biggest movie in pre-sales history at the North American box office. The film is behind Spider-Man: Brand New Day , Avengers: Endgame, and No Way Home in pre-sales collections in North America.
According to the data, Avengers: Doomsday has surpassed the global haul of Avengers: Endgame Encore to become the second-highest-grossing superhero movie of the year worldwide, even before hitting screens. Avengers: Endgame Encore collected an estimated $143.1 million at the worldwide box office.
1. Spider-Man: Brand New Day – $2.52 billion 2. Avengers: Doomsday – $150 million [pre-sales] 3. Avengers: Endgame Encore – $143.1 million
The film begins 14 months after the events of Thunderbolts, with the multiverse on the verge of collapse. As realities collide, heroes from three different universes, including the Avengers, Wakandans, New Avengers, Fantastic Four , and X-Men, unite to confront the formidable Doctor Doom and prevent an existential threat. Avengers: Doomsday will be released on December 18.
Note: Box office numbers are based on estimates and various sources. Numbers have not been independently verified by Koimoi.
